description: This file defines a JUnit test class SecurePayServiceTest for testing SecurePay payment service integrations within the OFBiz framework. It includes setup test data, and test methods for authorization, capture, refund, and credit operations against the payment gateway.

classes.name: SecurePayServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class extending OFBizTestCase to perform unit tests on SecurePay payment services, including authorization, capture, refund, and credit operations.

methods.name: testAuth
methods.description: Tests the authorization process for a credit card transaction via SecurePay, verifying success response and storing response details.

methods.name: testdoCapture
methods.description: Tests capturing a previously authorized payment, verifies success, and updates response reference number.

methods.name: testdoRefund
methods.description: Tests refund operation for a payment, verifying the response success.

methods.name: testdoCredit
methods.description: Tests crediting a customer account with a refund amount, and verifies success.
